name: Shiken Yasumi wa Mitsu no Aji
source:
Hero attends high school for a week during the time of holidays and familiar people are much more friendly during the holidays. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
假期里，主人公仍有一周时间必须前往高中。与平时相比，那些熟悉的人在假期中似乎都变得格外亲切。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
